cause_quote: The original engine capped the findings array at `{ maxItems: 12 }` and passed the entire model reply directly to `parseValue(extractionSchema, await model(...))`, so a thirteenth finding caused it to discard the whole reply.
user_saw: A portable deep research run could end as partial with no findings when the model returned too many items in a list.
summary: The fix trims selected model reply lists before validation, bounds start and resume results, and makes the side panel the sole Control UI entry point for deep research.
reasoning: I checked the original portable engine diff and its subsequent path history: the first implementation already rejected whole replies when a list exceeded its schema limit and returned a partial result on validation failure. The fix PR reports a live run that recovered seven findings after the change, and its added test covers overlong planning, extraction, and audit lists. The side-panel-only change addresses a separate UI decision.
